attributes.action: Protect the NHS and Public Purse: Require Auditable Supervision of Legal Fees
attributes.additional_details:
If the NHS and public purse pay for supervised legal work, the evidence should prove who did the work, who supervised it, how it was supervised, when it was handed over, who approved it and whether the legal bill accurately reflects that work.
The digital trail should cross-check contemporaneous evidence, document metadata, timestamps, version histories, case-management records, communications, time records, handovers and supervisory approvals so that each material stage validates the next.
attributes.background:
Petition brought by Liverpool Football Club legend Ian Rush MBE and Justice for Sport.
A need for a cross-validated digital supervision trail for complex legal work charged to the NHS and other public bodies, for work undertaken by unauthorised persons under the supervision of authorised lawyers.

rejection.details:
We're not sure what you want the UK Government or Parliament to do. 

We also can't accept petitions that contain names of individuals or that are about an individual case. 

If you think there has been wrongdoing by a legal firm you can find out how to complain to the ombudsman here: https://www.legalombudsman.org.uk/how-to-complain/
